notes: Seed domain www.kendallcountytx.gov reset the connection on robots.txt (fetch module refused); the same CivicPlus site on www.co.kendall.tx.us loads (found by one web search). Clarity elections.json is an empty list, so EIDs were taken from the county's Election Results (Past & Present) page. In each election the first night update (7:23 PM 2024, 7:16 PM primary, 7:01 PM runoff) carries early-vote precinct numbers only; election-day precinct votes then grow across later night updates (2024: 2 updates; primary: 3; runoff: 3). Several versions return 404. 2024 also has a pre-election version stamped 10/23/2024 8:04 PM with nonzero precinct values (not on election night, ignored). Check 3 not needed.
tag_rationale: All three elections are LIVE by check 1 (election-day precinct votes in two or more election-night Clarity updates), so the tag is LIVE_PRECINCT with high confidence.
